dataset.name: Swiss Dwellings
dataset.attribution: Standfest, M., Franzen, M., Schröder, Y., Gonzalez Medina, L., Villanueva Hernandez, Y., Buck, J. H., Tan, Y.-L., Niedzwiecka, M., Colmegna, R. (2023). Swiss Dwellings: A large dataset of apartment models. Archilyse AG. Zenodo.
dataset.changes: A subset of single-floor apartments. Rooms, walls, doors and windows only (features, balconies, stairs and simulation results dropped). Rotated so walls run along the axes, translated to the origin, rounded to 1 cm.
